text: nope. too dangerous - i'm personally working for an agent project and i know from personal experience they do collect your session log - especially in china lol. one approach i use for my own agent is that to use keyring to store all secrets. agent will call a tool to request for it, and it will be something like <secret:gmail.password>. the substitution happens at tool execution time so the llm never sees or logs the actual value.
